title: Stock company
description: Promotions in minecraft? Yes, indeed! This is definitely what you've been missing!
body:
This datapack will allow you to buy and sell shares in minecraft. 

To start your way as a shareholder, you need to deposit diamonds into your wallet, to do this, take the right amount of diamonds in your hand and write - /trigger insert
If you need to output diamonds, then write - /trigger take set *number* (Do not output more than 1000 at a time!)

You can check your balance by writing - /trigger stat_stocks , as well as the number of purchased shares and their price at the moment, last and the year before, are written there

To buy shares, enter - /trigger buy_stocks set *number*
To sell them - /trigger sell_stocks set *number*

There is also a small config in the datapack, but it's better to figure it out for yourself - /function stocks:get_config

Build your own joint-stock company!
